reason: I'd wait for a Groupon or a free trial day before paying anything, and the zoo is free so I don't feel a need. I'm not committing to $49-59 a month for a place I haven't seen with my baby in it.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Ages 8 months to 5 in one room worries me, and I can't tell if there's a separate baby area.
would_change_my_mind: A free or discounted trial visit or Groupon, plus a clear baby-only zone or separate sessions for under-1s so I can see it's safe.
